question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e.** ' And'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The reason** "and" **is the correct option here is that the conjunction "both" is typically paired with "and" to emphasize that the two linked elements are to be considered together. 
 
• When using** "both"** in a sentence, **it's a signal that **the terms or concepts being linked are equally emphasized or relevant. 
 
• Therefore, in this sentence, the **writer is underscoring **that the religion has taught the world two concepts, tolerance and universal acceptance, that are equally important.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *"I am proud to belong to a religion which has taught the world both tolerance **and **universal acceptance," he declared (3) _________ September 11, 1893. "We believe not only in universal toleration, (4) __________ we accept all religions as true. I am proud to belong to a nation which has sheltered the persecuted and the (5) _________ of all religions and all nations of the earth."*
